Structural cue: the people issue on the same `يومئذ` as earth’s reporting, and the purpose clause says they are made to see their deeds. Assigned role: `يصدر` supplies the movement away from a source after arrival; `أشتاتا` supplies divided exits; `ليروا` supplies the destination/purpose of visibility. Abductive move: I infer an assembly-source from which groups depart because the verb’s water-source branch and the scene’s judgment purpose cohere. Reading change: the ayah becomes a controlled post-arrival dispersal from a source of disclosure, not random scattering.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000775/B001","root_000775/B003","root_000849/B006"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-3","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_6faa6f2c7078a2f97684","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"99:6:2\",\"root_000849\",[\"B006\"]],[\"99:6:4\",\"root_000775\",[\"B001\",\"B003\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Kalabalık, sonraki tekil hesap için ayrı sorumluluk birimlerine bölünür; dağılma yalnızca kargaşa değildir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000531/B001","root_000849/B004","root_001046/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:4","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_8078a815791b6b165076","text":"4. **People are confronted with outputs that issued from themselves.** Fixed `ص د ر/B004` supplies a source from which actions issue. In the same ayah, fixed `ع م ل/B001` names intentional acts, the possessive `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ` attaches those acts to the people, and fixed `ر ء ي/B012` makes them be shown; 99:7-8 then shift to each actor directly seeing (`ر ء ي/B001`). These elements form an actor-output feedback structure. The packet does not state that the semantic \"source\" is each person, so that return arrow is inferred. `يَصْدُرُ` then resonates with deeds issuing from agents and being presented back to those agents.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000531/B005"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:5","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_821a53143a1ae8cd3cae","text":"5. **Visibility is taken out of the actor's control.** Fixed `ر ء ي/B005` supplies acting so that people will see, while fixed `B012` supplies causing another to see. Here `ٱلنَّاسُ`, `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ`, and the causative/passive `يُرَوْا۟` reverse the ostentatious arrangement: people do not control a display to others; they are made recipients of the display of their own acts. The branch serves as a corrective foil. The inference is that this compelled audience replaces socially managed visibility. The purpose clause therefore reads as exposure to one's work, not performance before a chosen audience.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000849/B005","root_001046/B003","root_001046/B004"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:4","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_8ba343c87cc5d085aeb1","text":"4. **Works as official charge and wage.** Lexical evidence: `ع م ل B003` holding/assigning official charge; `ع م ل B004` wage/pay for work; activated by `ص د ر B005` liability on money and `ث ق ل B004` measured weight in 99:7-8. Structural cue: people are made to see `أعمالهم`, and the next clauses quantify tiny units. Assigned role: works are both deeds performed and account-lines assigned to workers. Abductive move: I infer a labor-accounting frame: intentional work generates payable/liable outcome. Reading change: the ayah is not simply autobiographical replay; it is a summons to see one’s earned account.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000531/B012","root_000849/B001","root_000849/B004","root_001046/B001"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-2","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_8bd1d2b33709ac4a8186","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"99:6:2\",\"root_000849\",[\"B001\",\"B004\"]],[\"99:6:5\",\"root_000531\",[\"B012\"]],[\"99:6:6\",\"root_001046\",[\"B001\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"İnsanların çıkışı, içlerinden kaynaklanan işlerin öne çıkarılıp sahiplerine geri gösterildiği bir yüzleşme düzeni kazanır.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000059/B001","root_004965/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:5","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_a62e588503bf451387cc","text":"5. **Swaying mass becomes visible humans.** Lexical evidence: `ن و س B001` swaying/dangling oscillation; `ء ن س B001/B002` human visible presence/perception in 99:3; activated by `ز ل ز ل B001` shaking. Structural cue: the root listed for `الناس` is `ن و س`, not `ء ن س`; it follows the earlier earth-shake and precedes scattering. Assigned role: people are characterized as unstable, moved, and then forced into perception. Abductive move: I infer that human collectivity physically/morally oscillates under the quake before being sorted. Reading change: `الناس` reads as a shaken, wavering mass rather than a stable assembly.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000849/B006"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_ba83e591d795ce0316b0","text":"3. **Scattering performs individualized partition rather than mere disorder.** Fixed `ص د ر/B006` supplies a portion or group, while fixed `ش ت ت/B003` supplies distance and loss of union. The ayah consequently reads as an adjudicative partition of people, not only a chaotic scattering.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000531/B012"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_bd7a673f9faa77caabcf","text":"The twice-repeated singular `مَن يَعْمَلْ ... يَرَهُ` in 99:7-8 was the decisive later correction: it showed that `أَشْتَاتًا` is not exhausted by chaotic dispersal but can function as partition for person-specific attribution. The shift from fixed `يُرَوْا۟` (`ر ء ي/B012`, being shown) to later `يَرَهُ` (`B001`, directly seeing) also completed the actor-output feedback loop and confirmed that the purpose clause removes control over visibility.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000452/B001","root_000775/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_c0ba0372e00aa353299d","text":"3. **Scattered groups as differentiated moral/accounting categories.** Lexical evidence: `ش ت ت B001` scattering, difference among kinds/hearts; activated by 99:7/99:8’s mirrored good/evil outcomes and `خ ي ر B001` versus `ش ر ر B001`. Structural cue: 99:6 precedes two parallel clauses splitting tiny good and tiny evil. Assigned role: `أشتاتا` marks separation by kinds or hearts before the detailed good/evil display. Abductive move: I infer that the dispersal is not merely spatial but classificatory, because the next two ayat divide action by moral polarity and measure. Reading change: the ayah reads as sorting into differentiated evidentiary paths.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000849/B001","root_001046/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_d1144ef59f86e6d49c81","text":"2. **Chest/interior comes forward.** Lexical evidence: `ص د ر B001` chest as bodily front and `ص د ر B004` source from which actions issue; `ع م ل B001` intentional doing; activated by 99:3’s human inner question (`ق و ل B012`) and 99:4’s inner knowledge (`خ ب ر B001`). Structural cue: humans move out to be shown deeds; what was inside intention becomes outwardly visible. Assigned role: `صدر` bridges interior source and frontal exposure. Abductive move: I supply that deeds issue from inner chests/sources and are then set before their owners because the packet connects intention/work, seeing, and outward movement.
